literature_reviewer.conclusion: Semantify-NN already covers multi-parameter photometric transformations with clipping and fixed classifier margins. Fong-Vedaldi covers predictive explanation via deletion/retention and combined regions. CLEVER covers margin and local sensitivity stability. Exact three-image-calibrated joint-only clipping diagnostics on real captured joint changes were not found in these three papers. This bounded check is not proof of novelty.
strong_comparators_requested_before_exec: Unweighted and spatially shuffled cue overlap if weighting is used
Direct model evaluation on the reconstructed joint image
literature_reviewer.amendment_implemented_before_execution: Protocol v2 adds total predicted joint saturation T and direct reconstructed joint query D. No saliency-weighted predictor is implemented. No photo-model execution occurred before the lock.
literature_reviewer.clarification: Reviewer initially considered a pixel-unsaturated-single stratum. The executed eligibility only requires single classification correct, so S is not constant zero. B, S, T are not independent features: T=B+S in the chosen transform.

math_and_design_reviewer.pre_execution: One informative development diagnostic, no outcome leakage: B/S/margin/eligibility do not use joint predictions. The two checkpoints and images are dependent, not independent replicates. Fix risk-score direction. AUC comparison is not evidence of conditional incremental information. Encoded-RGB software boundary is not a real RAW intervention.
math_and_design_reviewer.post_execution: Static review confirms two models each have64 eligible images and0 new joint errors, so every AUC is undefined. The weak_diagnostic_screen_supported false flag means not supported, not diagnostic useless. T=B+S; reconstructed-joint query only verifies software. Cannot infer natural robustness, TA benefit or no red dependence. Stop adjusting gain/score or finding positive cases on these64 photos.

disposition: General clipping/classification boundary example demoted to classroom mechanism illustration. Specific real-capture predictive diagnostic remains unvalidated and is not a current contribution claim or priority candidate. No tuning after this event-limited development result.
